title: Responsibilities to Coastal Indigenous Peoples and Lands
description: Introductory survey centering local lands and Coast Salish protocols and examining Canadian political relationships with First Nations, Inuit and Metis peoples. Maps BC nations and territories to highlight relationships of land, water and people, including what it means to be a good guest here. Covers both histories of encroachment and histories of resistance and revitalization. Community-based knowledge holders contribute throughout.
